Data Structures (ds.data)#

Schema validation and data splitting utilities.

Schema Validation#

deepscenic.data.validate_schema(mdata, mode='training', strict=False)[source]#

Validate MuData against deepSCENIC schema.

Parameters:

  • mdata (MuData) – Data to validate

  • mode ({'training', 'inference'}) – Validation mode: - ‘training’: require rna + atac + r2g (strict) - ‘inference’: require rna only (flexible)

  • strict (bool) – If True, raise errors. If False, collect warnings.

Returns:

List of validation issues (empty if valid)

Return type:

list[str]

Raises:

SchemaError – If strict=True and validation fails

Examples

>>> # Validate for training (strict)
>>> validate_schema(mdata, mode="training", strict=True)

>>> # Validate for inference (RNA-only OK)
>>> validate_schema(mdata, mode="inference")
deepscenic.data.is_valid_schema(mdata, mode='training')[source]#

Check if MuData conforms to schema without raising.

Return type:

bool

Parameters:

  • mdata (MuData)

  • mode (str)

exception deepscenic.data.SchemaError[source]#

Raised when MuData doesn’t conform to deepSCENIC schema.

class deepscenic.data.SchemaWarning[source]#

Warning for non-critical schema issues.

Data Splitting#

deepscenic.data.get_split(mdata, modality, cells='all', features='all')[source]#

Get a specific cell×feature split from MuData.

Parameters:

  • mdata (MuData) – Input multimodal data

  • modality ({'rna', 'atac'}) – Which modality to extract

  • cells ({'train', 'test', 'all'}) – Which cell split to use

  • features ({'train', 'test', 'all'}) – Which feature split to use

Returns:

Subset of the requested modality

Return type:

AnnData

Examples

>>> import deepscenic as ds
>>> mdata = ds.read("dataset.h5mu")
>>> rna_train = ds.data.get_split(mdata, "rna", cells="train", features="train")
>>> rna_e2 = ds.data.get_split(mdata, "rna", cells="train", features="test")
class deepscenic.data.TrainingView(mdata)[source]#

Convenient view into MuData for training access patterns.

Provides easy access to all 4 cell×feature combinations for each modality, plus R2G matrices aligned with the correct ordering.

Parameters:

mdata (MuData) – Input multimodal data (must have valid deepSCENIC schema)

rna_train#

Train cells × train genes (main training data)

Type:

AnnData

rna_test#

Test cells × test genes (held-out evaluation)

Type:

AnnData

rna_e2#

Train cells × test genes (E2 matrix learning)

Type:

AnnData

rna_eval#

Test cells × train genes (reconstruction evaluation)

Type:

AnnData

atac_train#

Train cells × train regions

Type:

AnnData

atac_test#

Test cells × test regions

Type:

AnnData

atac_e2#

Train cells × test regions

Type:

AnnData

atac_eval#

Test cells × train regions

Type:

AnnData

r2g_train#

R2G penalty matrix for train regions × train genes

Type:

sparse matrix

r2g_test#

R2G penalty matrix for test regions × test genes

Type:

sparse matrix

Examples

>>> import deepscenic as ds
>>> mdata = ds.read("dataset.h5mu")
>>> view = ds.data.TrainingView(mdata)
>>> view.rna_train.shape
(31576, 12832)
>>> view.r2g_train.shape
(438728, 12832)
